# saferm

```go
import "github.com/shdeen/saferm/cmd/saferm"
```

Command saferm provides recoverable deletion and reversible moves.

## Variables

<a name="helpTemplate"></a>helpTemplate holds the help copy as named templates: the usage and arguments of each command, and the usage of each flag. A flag that takes a value names that value between backquotes in its usage, which is where urfave/cli reads the name that it shows beside the flag.

```go
var helpTemplate = template.Must(template.New("appstrings").Funcs(template.FuncMap{"statuses": helpStatuses, "join": strings.Join}).ParseFS(helpTemplates, "templates/appstrings.tmpl"))
```

<a name="helpTemplates"></a>helpTemplates contains the layout of the help page and the help copy.

```go
var helpTemplates embed.FS
```

<a name="configureHelp"></a>
## func configureHelp

```go
func configureHelp(command *cli.Command)
```

configureHelp sets the layout of the help page, the handler for usage errors, the help copy, and a \-\-help flag on the command and on every command beneath it. It panics when the layout cannot be read.

<a name="deferCommandExit"></a>
## func deferCommandExit

```go
func deferCommandExit(context.Context, *cli.Command, error)
```

deferCommandExit handles a command error by doing nothing, which leaves reporting the error to execute and exiting to main.

<a name="execute"></a>
## func execute

```go
func execute(ctx context.Context, command *cli.Command, commandLineArguments []string) error
```

execute runs the command line. On failure, it writes the error to the command's error stream, as JSON when the operation was given \-\-json, and returns the error joined with any failure to write it.

func main()

## func newCommand

func newCommand() *cli.Command

newCommand builds the saferm root command with its operation and help commands. It also replaces cli.ShowCommandHelp with showCommandHelp.

<a name="runCommand"></a>
## func runCommand

```go
func runCommand(ctx context.Context, command *cli.Command) error
```

runCommand translates a parsed operation command into a saferm.Request and carries it out on the command's input, output, and error streams.

<a name="showCommandHelp"></a>
## func showCommandHelp

```go
func showCommandHelp(ctx context.Context, command *cli.Command, topic string) error
```

showCommandHelp writes the help page for the named subcommand of the command. A command that has no subcommands is itself looked up by name in its parent.

<a name="showHelp"></a>
## func showHelp

```go
func showHelp(ctx context.Context, command *cli.Command) error
```

showHelp writes the help page for the command path that the arguments name, or the root help page when there are no arguments. It returns ErrInputInvalid for an unknown command name.

<a name="stringFlag"></a>
## func stringFlag

```go
func stringFlag(name string) *cli.StringFlag
```

stringFlag declares a string flag that applies only to its own command. The flag's usage is the help copy for its name.
